mapper.sql: T.TOC_SN AS tocSn, T.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, T.TOC_FORM_SN AS tocFormSn, T.UP_TOC_SN AS upTocSn, T.TOC_SE_CD AS tocSeCd, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm, T.SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq, T.PIC_ID AS picId, U.USER_NM AS picNm, T.EXPC_PAGE_CNT AS expcPageCnt, T.PRGRS_STTS_CD AS prgrsSttsCd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR R WHERE R.TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN) AS rqtCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC C WHERE C.UP_TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN) AS childCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N') AS fileCnt
mapper.select: SELECT , LEVEL - 1 AS depth FROM TB_TOC T LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.PIC_ID WHERE T.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND T.TOC_SE_CD = #{tocSeCd} START WITH T.UP_TOC_SN IS NULL AND T.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND T.TOC_SE_CD = #{tocSeCd} CONNECT BY PRIOR T.TOC_SN = T.UP_TOC_SN ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.SORT_SEQ, T.TOC_SN
mapper.sql: F.TOC_FORM_SN AS tocFormSn, F.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, F.TOC_FORM_NM AS tocFormNm, F.TOC_SE_CD AS tocSeCd, F.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, F.USE_YN AS useYn
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.TOC_FORM_SN = F.TOC_FORM_SN) AS itemCnt FROM TB_TOC_FORM F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID WHERE F.TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND F.TOC_SE_CD = #{tocSeCd} AND F.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY F.TOC_FORM_SN DESC
SELECT FROM TB_TOC_FORM F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID WHERE F.TOC_FORM_SN = #{tocFormSn}

SELECT , LEVEL - 1 AS depth FROM TB_TOC T LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.PIC_ID WHERE T.TOC_FORM_SN = #{tocFormSn} START WITH T.UP_TOC_SN IS NULL AND T.TOC_FORM_SN = #{tocFormSn} CONNECT BY PRIOR T.TOC_SN = T.UP_TOC_SN ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.SORT_SEQ, T.TOC_SN
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC_FORM WHERE TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND TOC_FORM_NM = #{tocFormNm}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TOC_FORM (TEAM_SN, TOC_FORM_NM, TOC_SE_CD, RGTR_ID, USE_YN) VALUES (#{teamSn}, #{tocFormNm}, #{tocSeCd}, #{rgtrId}, 'Y')

INSERT INTO TB_TOC (TOC_FORM_SN, UP_TOC_SN, TOC_SE_CD, TOC_NO, TOC_NM, SORT_SEQ, EXPC_PAGE_CNT) VALUES (#{tocFormSn}, #{upTocSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{tocSeCd}, #{tocNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tocNm}, #{sortSeq}, #{expcPageCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TOC (PBANC_SN, UP_TOC_SN, TOC_SE_CD, TOC_NO, TOC_NM, SORT_SEQ, PIC_ID, EXPC_PAGE_CNT, PRGRS_STTS_CD) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{upTocSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{tocSeCd}, #{tocNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tocNm}, #{sortSeq}, #{picId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expcPageCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'TS010')
